C0039.title: Code-word ordering and empty parcel shipping: exploiting consumer vouchers for 400,000 yuan, 12 charged with fraudulent redemption
C0039.summary: Yang proposed cooperation in early 2024; Li decided to participate in mid-October 2024, and the two formally organized order brushers in early November to place orders using platform consumer vouchers. Li's store used empty-parcel shipping and other methods to fabricate transactions and defraud the platform of subsidies. Shanghai Putuo procuratorial material described a chain involving merchants, order brushers, and organizers, with 12 suspects prosecuted for fake consumer-voucher redemption and platform-subsidy fraud.
